_comment: Every balance the chain starts with. Nothing else may hold one — genesis_test.go
fails the build if it does.
The ads-for-gas hot wallet used to be here with 10,000 ERTH. It is gone: its key
was a devnet key that had been on a laptop, and a launch genesis is not the place
to fund an operational wallet from one. Fund it after launch from the validator,
with a key that has never left a signer.
'keyed' accounts are added with `earthd genesis add-genesis-account`, which writes
auth, bank.balances and bank.supply together. That is the whole reason the tool is
used instead of editing the file: the three have to move as one, and hand-editing
them is how you ship a genesis whose supply does not equal its balances.
'modules' are module accounts. They are NOT added with add-genesis-account, which
would write a BaseAccount at an address x/auth must later hold a ModuleAccount at.
Their balances go straight into bank, and the supply is recomputed from the sum.
x/auth creates the ModuleAccount itself on first use.

keyed.note: The genesis validator. 1,000 ERTH: enough to self-delegate 100, and to fund governance deposits (5 ERTH expedited, 1 normal) for years. Deliberately small — 0.00004% of the pre-mine — because the validator's real income is the staking pillar, which pays 1 ERTH/sec split by voting power, and a large genesis balance on top of that is an allocation nobody voted for. Address derived from the operator address of the running devnet validator; the key itself is the VALIDATOR_MNEMONIC in the gitignored .env and is not in this repo.

Devnet faucet/test account. 10,000 ERTH, enough to exercise transfers, swaps, governance deposits and a second validator's self-delegation without topping up. Its mnemonic is DEV_MNEMONIC in the gitignored .env of the deploy repo and is not in this repository. REMOVE THIS ACCOUNT before the real launch genesis: it is a key that has been on a laptop, and nothing on mainnet should be funded from one.

modules.name: dex
modules.note: Three quarters of the pre-mine, plus pool 1's ANML and its LP shares. uerth = pool 1's reserve (630,720,000,000,000) + both auction earmarks (630,720,000,000,000 each). The fourth quarter is the registration-reward pool and sits on the allocation module account below. dexlp/1 = sqrt(reserve_erth * reserve_token). genesis_test.go re-derives both from app_state.json rather than trusting these numbers.

modules.name: allocation
modules.note: The registration-reward pool: one quarter of the pre-mine, backing allocation.registration_reward_seed in app_state.json. It is a real balance and not a promise because emission is minted as it accrues rather than when it is claimed, so an option that says it holds ERTH has to be holding it. genesis_test.go checks the two figures against each other.
